setting: The ancient kingdom of Hastinapur, with its grand palaces and bustling courtyards, serves as the backdrop for the unfolding saga.

episodes.title: अंधकार की पहली किरण
episodes.description: An ominous omen sparks the first clash of destiny in Hastinapur.
episodes.summary: The dawn over Hastinapur is broken by a sudden, blood‑red comet that frightens the courtiers and whispers of war; Krishna appears in the palace garden, his eyes reflecting the strange sky, and warns that the balance of dharma is about to tilt. Arjuna trains with his bow, haunted by doubts, while Draupadi receives a cryptic message about a hidden weapon in the palace vault; the trio faces sabotage from unseen forces, and a sudden attack by a band of rogue Kaurava soldiers forces them into a desperate defense, testing their resolve and unity. Just as Krishna prepares to reveal the true nature of the comet, the palace walls tremble and the vault bursts open, spilling a glowing, ancient artifact that hums with power; Arjuna reaches for it, but a shadowy figure steps from the darkness, and the episode ends with the artifact’s light blinding the screen, leaving the fate of the heroes unknown.

episodes.title: छायाओं की पुकार
episodes.description: A cloaked stranger seizes the glowing artifact, thrusting कृष्ण, अर्जुन, and द्रौपदी into a perilous chase through hidden corridors and betrayals.
episodes.summary: The blinding glare of the artifact fades, revealing a shadow‑cloaked figure emerging from the vault, its hand clutching the humming relic and murmuring a warning that the sky itself is dying. कृष्ण steps forward, his golden dhoti shimmering, and his voice steadies the trembling courtiers, while अर्जुन’s bow twitches, ready to strike. द्रौपदी watches the figure’s eyes, catching a flicker of a forgotten sigil that hints at ancient technology. As the stranger retreats, अर्जुन pursues, only to be ambushed by rogue Kaurava soldiers hidden behind marble pillars, forcing him into a desperate duel that shatters a column. द्रौपदी deciphers the sigil on the artifact, discovering it is a quantum seed capable of rewriting dharma itself, but its activation requires a lost mantra encoded in the palace’s oldest scroll. कृष्ण intervenes, using his divine insight to locate the scroll, yet a trusted palace guard betrays them, sealing the vault and trapping the trio inside a collapsing hallway. The artifact pulses wildly, threatening to overload the palace’s energy core. In the vault’s dying light, the cloaked figure activates the seed, tearing a rift in time that engulfs कृष्ण, अर्जुन, and द्रौपदी, pulling them toward a swirling vortex of distant ages. Just as the vortex threatens to consume them, a resonant voice echoes—“सत्यमेव जयते”—promising a hidden lineage that may control the seed’s power. The episode ends with the trio grasping each other's hands as the vortex snaps shut, leaving the palace trembling and the shadowy figure’s true identity still veiled, setting the stage for the next confrontation.
